title: Chen, He, Zhou, Bu (PKU, submitted 2026-11-12): resistance to AI-assisted writing among first authors (arXiv 2611.16833)
materials: CARRIED: Grok's assessment, relayed by Claude 2026-11-15. Grok's stated reads: the paper's abstract, introduction and methods; a CASRAI writeup (2026-11-15); an alphaXiv summary. Results and limitations sections: read depth not stated. Data as relayed: OpenAlex snapshot 2026-09-23; 71,133 first authors; 565,602 publications, 2023 to Sep 2026.
decision_context: Specimen for the section-level read ceiling (Card 07 4b): results claims carried from a press writeup and a snippet, beside a methods claim read in full. Not an assessment for a decision.

tools.output: Threshold alpha >= 0.1 comes from the same group's earlier work (not an independent calibration). The robustness check with Qwen is a same-family model, not an independent detector. Relayed premises; not checked here.
